commitMessage:
Add seeder for initial Pantauku accounts and device assignment

scripts/seed-pantauku.py uses the Traccar REST API to create a direct
customer (soka9), a reseller (tempeCorp) with its customer (soka23),
and driver accounts, then links chosen devices and tags them with the
billing payer. Dry run by default; --apply writes. Credentials come
from environment variables only.
